prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 电子发票常见问题 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "问题" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 253px
  col 2: header "回答" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 1248px
  col 3: header "相关链接" · longest unbreakable word 175px · one-line width 190px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 538px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 537px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者查找电子发票的常见问题，并阅读对应的解答和相关链接。","reading":"读者先扫描首列问题，找到所需主题后横向阅读回答，再按需使用同一行的链接；回答较长，预计会决定多数行的高度，问题和链接可在这些行高中适度换行。","groups":["问题与回答构成每行的问答对，应通过同一行的对齐关系保持关联。","相关链接是各问题的补充入口，与同一行的问答关联，但承担导航而非解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["相关链接中最长的连续字符串，至少需要175px文字宽度。","问题和回答中的连续词语及标识符应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["问题可按中文自然断行，但应保持易于逐行扫描。","回答可按中文自然断行；长回答会形成较高的行。","链接文字中允许断行的部分可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [115, 216, 206] · table 538×898px · row heights [33, 154, 134, 134, 154, 154, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [125, 216, 196] · table 538×898px · row heights [33, 154, 134, 134, 154, 154, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [105, 236, 196] · table 538×817px · row heights [33, 134, 134, 114, 134, 134, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"问题列的粗体和浅色背景有助于定位主题；问答和链接按行对齐，所有表头及连续字符串保持完整。","problems":"回答列较窄，长段落形成密集的七行文字；链接列有较多空白，两个网址仍在连字符处换行。","cause":"回答列仅216px，而链接列占206px；多给链接的10px未能使这两个网址完整显示。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"问题列比r2A更宽，部分问题的断行更自然；196px的链接列仍能容纳最长连续字符串。","problems":"回答仍显拥挤，行高和r2A相同；两个网址仍分成两行，链接列下方留白较多。","cause":"回答列仍为216px；增加的宽度给了问题列，未改善占主要阅读量的回答。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"回答列更宽，段落较易阅读，多数行的高度下降；链接列保持连续字符串完整，问答与链接的行对应关系清楚。","problems":"问题列偏窄，部分问题被切成四行，末尾出现单独的“吗？”或“效？”，削弱了首列的扫描节奏；回答末行也有单字收尾。","cause":"问题列仅105px，文字区为84px；回答列236px虽改善了整体排布，但个别段落仍在当前行宽下产生短末行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-230","widths":[111,230,196],"change":"在r2C基础上将6px从回答移给问题，尝试减少问题中的孤立短行，同时保留较宽的回答和链接所需的最小宽度。"},{"name":"question-116","widths":[116,225,196],"change":"进一步扩大问题列，比较首列扫描节奏能否明显改善，以及回答增加的换行是否值得。"},{"name":"answer-241","widths":[100,241,196],"change":"将更多空间用于回答，测试较宽正文能否改善段落断行，并观察更窄问题列是否仍可接受。"}]}
